```sql
SELECT DISTINCT l."ID"
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."Date" >= '1997-01-01' AND l."Date" < '1998-01-01'
AND p."First Date" <= '1998-06-01'
AND (
    l."GOT" > 40 OR
    l."GPT" > 40 OR
    l."LDH" > 250 OR
    l."ALP" > 120 OR
    l."TP" < 6.0 OR l."TP" > 8.5 OR
    l."ALB" < 3.5 OR l."ALB" > 5.5 OR
    l."UA" > 8.0 OR
    l."UN" > 20 OR
    l."CRE" > 1.2 OR
    l."T-BIL" > 1.2 OR
    l."T-CHO" > 250 OR
    l."TG" > 200 OR
    l."CPK" > 200 OR
    l."GLU" > 140 OR l."GLU" < 70 OR
    l."WBC" > 10.0 OR l."WBC" < 4.0 OR
    l."RBC" < 3.5 OR l."RBC" > 6.0 OR
    l."HGB" < 12.0 OR l."HGB" > 17.5 OR
    l."HCT" < 36.0 OR l."HCT" > 52.0 OR
    l."PLT" < 150 OR l."PLT" > 400 OR
    l."PT" < 10.0 OR l."PT" > 14.0 OR
    l."APTT" < 25 OR l."APTT" > 40 OR
    l."FG" < 1.5 OR l."FG" > 4.0 OR
    l."IGG" > 1700 OR l."IGG" < 700 OR
    l."IGA" > 400 OR l."IGA" < 70 OR
    l."IGM" > 230 OR l."IGM" < 40 OR
    l."C3" < 80 OR l."C3" > 180 OR
    l."C4" < 10 OR l."C4" > 40
)
ORDER BY l."ID";
```
